questions.question: In Daniel's vision, some who sleep in the dust will awake to everlasting life. What do the others awake to?

answers.text: A second life on the earth

questions.question: At the end of a vision about the time of the end, what was Daniel told to do with the words?

answers.text: Shut them up and seal the book
Read them aloud to the king
Teach them to the people at once

questions.question: In Daniel's vision, how long did the man dressed in linen say it would be until the wonders were fulfilled?

answers.text: A time and times and half a time

questions.question: At the very end of Daniel's last vision, what was he promised about his own future?

answers.text: He will rest and then arise to his inheritance
He will be taken up to heaven alive
He will rule over the Beautiful Land
